description: An application submitted under Section 96a of the Town & Country Planning Act 1990 for a Non-Material Amendment to vary Condition 2 (Approved Plans), of Planning Permission 23/3976/F in relation to South Cator Park Pavillion comprising amendments to the following:    Change to the quantum of non-residential floorspace (Nature Pavillion Building) including internal and external layout of the building, and use, resulting in amendments to Condition 17, 23 and 24.  Change to the wording of Condition 59 to allow a BREEAM rating from excellent to very good to be achieved for the Non-Residential Nature Pavilion Building, and inclusion of new condition (78) relating to the Energy and CO2 requirements of the Nature Pavillion. Change to the wording of Condition 54 (Cyle and Motorcycle Parking) to remove the requirement to provide locker and changing facilities for the Nature Pavillion.   (Updated Description)
site_name: London Wildlife Trust Pavilion within South Cator Park - Kidbrooke Village, London SE3
